title: What If You Drank Too Much Water?

lines.text: Rusty decided to drink six liters of water in three hours.
His kidneys can only get rid of about one liter per hour.
The rest stays in his blood, and dilutes the salt.
Now his blood is more watery than his cells, so water rushes into them.
And the cells swell up like balloons.
Most of his body can stretch.
But his brain is locked inside his skull, with nowhere to go.
So drink when you're thirsty, not to win a bet.
